# Centralized LLM Service Architecture

## Overview
The centralized LLM service provides a unified interface for all LLM interactions, with three-tier local model support and intelligent routing.

## Architecture Diagram
```
┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│             │     │               │     │                 │
│   Agents    ├────►│  LLMService   ├────►│ Routing Service │
│             │     │               │     │                 │
└─────────────┘     └───────────────┘     └────────┬────────┘
                                                    │
                                                    ▼
                    ┌───────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
                    │               │     │                 │
                    │ Local Models  │◄────┤ Provider Config │
                    │               │     │                 │
                    └───────────────┘     └────────┬────────┘
                                                    │
                                                    ▼
                                          ┌─────────────────┐
                                          │                 │
                                          │ External APIs   │
                                          │                 │
                                          └─────────────────┘
```

## Key Components

### LLMService
- Located at `apps/api/src/llms/llm.service.ts`
- Provides unified interface for all LLM interactions
- Coordinates between various specialized services
- Returns enhanced response with metadata

### CentralizedRoutingService
- Located at `apps/api/src/llms/centralized-routing.service.ts`
- Implements intelligent routing logic
- Analyzes request complexity
- Selects appropriate model tier

### LocalModelStatusService
- Located at `apps/api/src/llms/local-model-status.service.ts`
- Manages Ollama integration
- Monitors model health and availability
- Provides caching for status information

### Three-Tier Model System
- **Tier 1 (Fast Thinking)**: Complex reasoning (gpt-oss-2b, gpt-oss-20b)
- **Tier 2 (Ultra-Fast)**: Simple queries (llama3.2:1b, llama3.2:3b)
- **Tier 3 (General)**: Balanced performance (llama3.1:8b, qwen2.5:7b)
```

# Developer Onboarding: Centralized LLM Service

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- Access to development environment

### Basic Usage

```typescript
// Import the service
import { LLMService } from '../../llms/llm.service';

// Inject the service in your class constructor
constructor(private llmService: LLMService) {}

// Generate completion
const result = await this.llmService.generateResponse(
  'Tell me about centralized LLM services.',
  {
    systemPrompt: 'You are a helpful assistant.',
    dataClass: 'public',
    policyProfile: 'standard'
  }
);

// Access response content and metadata
console.log(result.response);
console.log(result.runMetadata);
```

### Data Classification
When making requests, always set the appropriate data classification:
- `public`: Non-sensitive information
- `internal`: Internal company information
- `confidential`: Sensitive business data
- `financial`: Financial or regulated data

### Policy Profiles
Available policy profiles:
- `standard`: Default policy
- `strict`: Enhanced privacy controls
- `research`: Allows model training for research

subtasks.description: Test the complete audit logging and compliance reporting pipeline in staging, including log generation, storage, immutability, redaction, and report generation.
subtasks.details: Simulate all key actions (sovereign mode decisions, policy enforcement, model/provider usage) and verify corresponding logs and reports. Review compliance with regulatory requirements.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end automated and manual tests covering all logging and reporting scenarios. Compliance review with audit stakeholders.

tasks.title: Update LLM Store and Model Listing Logic (Frontend)
tasks.description: Fetch and cache sovereign mode policy in the frontend, filter available models/providers based on policy, and handle policy changes in real time.
tasks.details: Use React (v18+) with Zustand (v4+) for state management. Fetch /api/sovereign-policy and /api/models on app load and on policy change events (via WebSocket or SSE). Filter model list in LLM selector UI. Use SWR (v2+) for caching and revalidation.
tasks.testStrategy: Component tests (React Testing Library v14+). E2E tests (Cypress v13+) for model filtering and policy change handling.

subtasks.title: Integrate Sovereign Policy and Model Fetching with SWR
subtasks.description: Implement logic to fetch /api/sovereign-policy and /api/models on app load using SWR for caching and revalidation.
subtasks.details: Set up SWR hooks to fetch and cache sovereign policy and model data. Ensure both endpoints are called on initial load and data is cached for efficient access.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to verify correct data fetching and caching behavior using React Testing Library.

subtasks.title: Implement Zustand Store for Sovereign Policy and Models
subtasks.description: Create a Zustand store to manage sovereign policy and model state, exposing actions to update state based on fetched data.
subtasks.details: Design the store to hold sovereign policy, model list, and provide actions for updating state when new data is fetched or policy changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to ensure the store updates state correctly and exposes necessary selectors and actions.

subtasks.title: Subscribe to Real-Time Policy Change Events
subtasks.description: Implement WebSocket or SSE subscription to listen for sovereign policy changes and trigger data refetch and store updates.
subtasks.details: Establish a connection to the backend for real-time policy change notifications. On receiving an event, trigger SWR revalidation and update Zustand store accordingly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate policy change events in tests and verify that the store and UI update in real time.

subtasks.title: Filter Model List in LLM Selector UI Based on Policy
subtasks.description: Update the LLM selector UI to display only models/providers allowed by the current sovereign policy.
subtasks.details: Implement filtering logic in the UI component, sourcing filtered models from the Zustand store. Ensure the UI reacts to policy changes and updates the displayed list accordingly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write component tests to verify correct filtering and UI updates using React Testing Library.

subtasks.title: End-to-End Testing for Model Filtering and Policy Change Handling
subtasks.description: Develop Cypress E2E tests to validate model filtering and real-time policy change handling in the frontend.
subtasks.details: Create E2E test scenarios covering initial load, model filtering, and dynamic updates when the policy changes via WebSocket or SSE.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Cypress to automate user flows and assert correct UI behavior under various policy and model configurations.

tasks.title: Implement Sovereign Mode Toggle and Indicators in UI
tasks.description: Add sovereign mode toggle in LLM selector, policy indicator badges, and compliance status displays in the frontend.
tasks.details: Extend LLM selector with a toggle (Material UI v5+ Switch). Show badges (e.g., Chip component) when sovereign mode is active. Add tooltips explaining implications (react-tooltip v5+). Display compliance status in conversation header. Ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.2).
tasks.testStrategy: UI snapshot tests. Accessibility audits (axe-core v4+). Manual verification of toggle, badges, and tooltips.

subtasks.title: Integrate Sovereign Mode Toggle in LLM Selector
subtasks.description: Add a toggle switch to the LLM selector UI using Material UI v5+ Switch, allowing users to enable or disable sovereign mode.
subtasks.details: Implement the toggle as a controlled component, ensuring state is managed by the parent. Use appropriate labeling and ensure the toggle is accessible per WCAG 2.2. Style the switch to match the application's theme.
subtasks.testStrategy: UI snapshot tests for toggle appearance and state. Accessibility audit using axe-core v4+ to verify keyboard navigation and screen reader support.

subtasks.title: Display Policy Indicator Badges for Sovereign Mode
subtasks.description: Show visual badges (e.g., using the Chip component) in the UI when sovereign mode is active, indicating current policy status.
subtasks.details: Render badges dynamically based on sovereign mode state. Use distinct colors and icons for clarity. Ensure badges are accessible and provide sufficient contrast.
subtasks.testStrategy: Snapshot tests for badge rendering. Manual verification of badge visibility and accessibility checks for color contrast and screen reader labels.

subtasks.title: Add Tooltips Explaining Sovereign Mode Implications
subtasks.description: Attach tooltips (using react-tooltip v5+) to the toggle and badges, providing users with contextual information about sovereign mode and its effects.
subtasks.details: Write concise, clear tooltip content explaining sovereign mode, policy enforcement, and compliance. Ensure tooltips are accessible and dismissible via keyboard.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manual verification of tooltip content and appearance. Accessibility audit for tooltip focus management and screen reader compatibility.

subtasks.title: Display Compliance Status in Conversation Header
subtasks.description: Show the current compliance status related to sovereign mode in the conversation header, updating dynamically as the mode or policy changes.
subtasks.details: Fetch and display compliance status from the relevant policy source. Use clear visual indicators and accessible text. Ensure updates are reflected in real time if policy changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Snapshot and integration tests for compliance status display. Manual tests for real-time updates and accessibility.

subtasks.title: Ensure Full Accessibility and WCAG 2.2 Compliance
subtasks.description: Audit and enhance all new UI elements (toggle, badges, tooltips, compliance status) to meet WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards.
subtasks.details: Perform comprehensive accessibility checks, including keyboard navigation, ARIA labeling, color contrast, and screen reader support. Address any identified issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Automated accessibility audits using axe-core v4+. Manual testing with screen readers and keyboard-only navigation.

tasks.title: Implement User Preferences for Sovereign Mode
tasks.description: Allow users to set sovereign mode preferences, with per-conversation override, respecting organization policy constraints.
tasks.details: Store user preferences in backend (PostgreSQL v15+). Expose via REST API (GET/POST /api/user/sovereign-preference). In frontend, persist per-conversation override in local state and sync with backend. Enforce org policy precedence in backend logic.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for preference storage and retrieval. E2E tests for override flows and policy constraint enforcement.

subtasks.title: Design User Preference Data Model in PostgreSQL
subtasks.description: Define and implement the schema for storing user sovereign mode preferences, supporting both global and per-conversation overrides, and ensuring compatibility with organization policy constraints.
subtasks.details: Create tables and relationships in PostgreSQL v15+ to persist user preferences, including fields for user ID, preference values, conversation context, and policy enforcement metadata.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for schema migrations and CRUD operations. Validate data integrity and constraint enforcement.

subtasks.title: Implement REST API Endpoints for Preference Management
subtasks.description: Develop REST API endpoints (GET/POST /api/user/sovereign-preference) to allow clients to retrieve and update user sovereign mode preferences, with support for per-conversation overrides.
subtasks.details: Ensure endpoints validate input, enforce organization policy precedence, and interact with the PostgreSQL backend. Document API contract and error handling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for API endpoints, including policy enforcement and override scenarios.

subtasks.title: Frontend State Management for Per-Conversation Overrides
subtasks.description: Implement frontend logic to persist per-conversation sovereign mode overrides in local state and synchronize changes with the backend via the REST API.
subtasks.details: Integrate local state management (e.g., React context or Redux) to track overrides, trigger API calls on change, and update UI accordingly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for state management logic and API synchronization.

subtasks.title: Backend Enforcement of Organization Policy Precedence
subtasks.description: Develop backend logic to ensure organization policy constraints always take precedence over user and conversation-level preferences when processing requests.
subtasks.details: Implement middleware or service-layer checks that resolve effective preference values based on org policy, user settings, and overrides.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for policy enforcement logic, including edge cases and conflicting settings.

subtasks.title: End-to-End Testing of Preference and Policy Flows
subtasks.description: Validate the complete flow of setting, overriding, and enforcing sovereign mode preferences across backend and frontend, including organization policy constraints.
subtasks.details: Develop E2E tests to simulate user interactions, preference updates, per-conversation overrides, and policy enforcement, ensuring correct behavior and UI feedback.
subtasks.testStrategy: Automated E2E tests for all flows; manual verification for complex or edge scenarios.

tasks.title: Enhance Model Routing for Fallback and Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement graceful fallback to local models and clear error messages when no compliant models are available under sovereign mode.
tasks.details: Update backend routing to check for local model availability. If none, follow FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR (error, local-only, prompt-user). Return descriptive error messages to frontend. Log all fallback events for audit.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate scenarios with no local models. Assert correct fallback and error messaging. Log verification.

subtasks.title: Update Backend Routing to Check Local Model Availability
subtasks.description: Modify backend routing logic to verify if compliant local models are available when operating under sovereign mode.
subtasks.details: Implement checks in the routing layer to determine local model presence before proceeding with request handling. Ensure this logic is invoked for every model selection under sovereign mode.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate requests under sovereign mode with and without local models. Assert correct detection and routing behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR Logic for Routing Decisions
subtasks.description: Integrate fallback behavior options (error, local-only, prompt-user) into the routing workflow when no compliant local models are found.
subtasks.details: Design and implement logic to follow the configured FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR, ensuring the system responds appropriately based on the selected fallback strategy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each fallback scenario by configuring different FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR settings and verifying correct system response.

subtasks.title: Return Descriptive Error Messages to Frontend
subtasks.description: Ensure that clear and informative error messages are sent to the frontend when no compliant models are available and fallback results in an error.
subtasks.details: Define error message formats and update API responses to include detailed context about the failure and fallback decision.
subtasks.testStrategy: Trigger error conditions and inspect frontend messages for clarity, completeness, and actionable information.

subtasks.title: Log All Fallback Events for Audit Purposes
subtasks.description: Record every fallback event, including routing decisions and error conditions, in the audit logging system for compliance and traceability.
subtasks.details: Integrate fallback event logging with the centralized audit system, capturing relevant metadata such as user, organization, policy, and model details.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate fallback scenarios and verify that all events are logged with correct granularity and context.

subtasks.title: Verify Fallback and Error Handling via Scenario-Based Testing
subtasks.description: Develop and execute tests that simulate scenarios with no local models to validate fallback logic, error messaging, and audit logging.
subtasks.details: Create automated and manual test cases covering all fallback paths and error conditions, ensuring system robustness and compliance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run scenario-based tests, inspect logs, and assert correct frontend messaging and routing behavior.

tasks.title: Implement Real-Time Policy Change Propagation
tasks.description: Ensure configuration changes (env vars, org policy) propagate to backend and frontend without restart, updating UI within 5 seconds.
tasks.details: Use chokidar (v3+) to watch env/config files in backend. On change, reload policy and notify frontend via WebSocket (socket.io v4+). In frontend, subscribe to policy change events and refresh state/UI. Debounce updates to avoid UI flicker.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for live config changes. E2E tests for UI update latency. Manual tests for edge cases.

subtasks.title: Configure Backend File Watcher for Policy and Env Changes
subtasks.description: Set up chokidar (v3+) in the backend to monitor environment variable and policy configuration files for changes in real time.
subtasks.details: Implement chokidar to watch relevant env/config files. Ensure watcher is robust against permission errors and atomic writes. Optimize for minimal CPU usage and cross-platform compatibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate file changes and verify watcher triggers events reliably across supported platforms. Test with various file editors and atomic write scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement Dynamic Policy Reload and Validation in Backend
subtasks.description: On file change, reload the updated policy and environment configuration in the backend, validate correctness, and update in-memory state without restarting the service.
subtasks.details: Parse and validate new config using existing schema validation (e.g., zod). Ensure atomicity and rollback on validation failure. Log reload events for auditability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for reload logic, including invalid config scenarios. Verify backend state reflects latest config after change.

subtasks.title: Notify Frontend of Policy Changes via WebSocket
subtasks.description: Emit policy change events from backend to all connected frontend clients using socket.io (v4+), ensuring delivery within 5 seconds of config change.
subtasks.details: Integrate socket.io event emission in backend reload handler. Include updated policy payload and timestamp. Handle reconnection and missed events gracefully.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests to verify event emission and delivery timing. Simulate network interruptions and ensure clients receive latest policy.

subtasks.title: Subscribe to Policy Change Events and Refresh Frontend State
subtasks.description: In the frontend, subscribe to policy change WebSocket events, update application state, and trigger UI refresh to reflect new policy.
subtasks.details: Implement event listener and state management logic. Ensure UI components reactively update based on new policy. Handle edge cases such as stale or duplicate events.
subtasks.testStrategy: E2E tests to verify UI updates within 5 seconds of backend change. Manual tests for edge cases and UI consistency.

subtasks.title: Debounce Frontend Updates to Prevent UI Flicker
subtasks.description: Implement debouncing logic in the frontend to batch rapid policy change events and avoid unnecessary or flickering UI updates.
subtasks.details: Use a debounce utility to delay UI refresh if multiple events arrive in quick succession. Tune debounce interval for responsiveness and stability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Automated tests for debounce behavior under rapid event bursts. Visual regression tests to confirm smooth UI transitions.

tasks.title: Develop Compliance Dashboard for Admins
tasks.description: Create an admin dashboard to view audit logs, compliance reports, and policy status.
tasks.details: Build dashboard in React (v18+) with Material UI (v5+). Fetch data from /api/sovereign-audit and /api/compliance-report. Provide filtering, export (CSV/PDF), and drill-down capabilities. Secure with RBAC (e.g., CASL v6+).
tasks.testStrategy: UI and integration tests for dashboard features. Security tests for RBAC enforcement.

subtasks.title: Design Dashboard Layout and UI Components
subtasks.description: Define the overall layout and structure of the compliance dashboard using React (v18+) and Material UI (v5+), including sections for audit logs, compliance reports, and policy status.
subtasks.details: Create wireframes and implement reusable UI components such as tables, filters, and cards to display audit logs, compliance reports, and policy status. Ensure responsive design and accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct UI tests to verify layout correctness, responsiveness, and accessibility compliance.

subtasks.title: Integrate Data Fetching from Backend APIs
subtasks.description: Implement logic to fetch audit logs and compliance reports from /api/sovereign-audit and /api/compliance-report endpoints.
subtasks.details: Use React hooks or state management to retrieve and manage data from the specified APIs. Handle loading, error, and empty states gracefully.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests to ensure correct data retrieval and error handling from APIs.

subtasks.title: Implement Filtering, Export, and Drill-Down Features
subtasks.description: Add filtering options, export functionality (CSV/PDF), and drill-down capabilities for detailed views within the dashboard.
subtasks.details: Enable users to filter data by date, type, or status. Provide export buttons for CSV and PDF formats. Allow users to click on entries for detailed drill-down views.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test filtering logic, export output accuracy, and drill-down navigation through UI and functional tests.

subtasks.title: Secure Dashboard with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
subtasks.description: Integrate RBAC using CASL (v6+) to restrict dashboard access and actions based on user roles.
subtasks.details: Define roles and permissions for admin users. Implement RBAC checks in both UI and API calls to ensure only authorized users can view or interact with dashboard features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform security tests to validate RBAC enforcement and attempt unauthorized access scenarios.

subtasks.title: Conduct End-to-End Testing and Documentation
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive end-to-end testing of the dashboard and document usage, configuration, and security considerations.
subtasks.details: Write test cases covering all dashboard features, including UI, data integration, filtering, export, drill-down, and RBAC. Prepare user and developer documentation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Execute end-to-end tests and review documentation for completeness and clarity.

tasks.title: Conduct Security Review and Compliance Validation
tasks.description: Perform security audit and validate compliance with data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
tasks.details: Use automated tools (e.g., Snyk, OWASP ZAP) for vulnerability scanning. Manual review of access controls, audit logging, and data flows. Validate that all sovereign mode features meet regulatory requirements. Document findings and remediation steps.
tasks.testStrategy: Security test reports. Compliance checklist validation. Penetration testing for critical flows.

subtasks.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scanning
subtasks.description: Use automated security tools (e.g., Snyk, OWASP ZAP) to scan the system for vulnerabilities and generate initial security reports.
subtasks.details: Configure and execute vulnerability scans across all relevant environments. Collect and review scan results for critical, high, and medium severity issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review automated scan reports for completeness and accuracy. Validate that all critical vulnerabilities are identified and documented.

subtasks.title: Conduct Manual Review of Access Controls and Audit Logging
subtasks.description: Manually assess access control mechanisms, audit logging, and data flow processes to identify gaps not covered by automated tools.
subtasks.details: Examine user roles, permissions, and audit log configurations. Trace data flows to ensure proper logging and access restrictions are enforced.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that access controls align with least privilege principles and that audit logs capture all relevant security events.

subtasks.title: Validate Compliance with Data Sovereignty Regulations
subtasks.description: Assess all sovereign mode features and data handling practices for compliance with applicable data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
subtasks.details: Map data storage locations, cross-border transfers, and processing activities. Compare practices against regulatory requirements and identify compliance gaps.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use a compliance checklist to validate alignment with each regulatory requirement. Document any areas of non-compliance.

subtasks.title: Document Findings and Recommend Remediation Steps
subtasks.description: Compile security and compliance findings into a structured report, including prioritized remediation actions for identified issues.
subtasks.details: Summarize vulnerabilities, access control gaps, and compliance deficiencies. Propose actionable remediation steps with responsible owners and timelines.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review report for clarity, completeness, and actionable recommendations. Ensure all findings are traceable to evidence.

subtasks.title: Verify Remediation and Establish Ongoing Monitoring
subtasks.description: Confirm that remediation actions have been implemented and set up ongoing monitoring for security and compliance posture.
subtasks.details: Re-test remediated items, update documentation, and configure automated monitoring tools for continuous compliance and security tracking.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate closure of all remediation items. Confirm monitoring alerts and periodic audit processes are operational.
